description: Source code for the RelationResolution class in Apache Spark SQL Catalyst module, responsible for resolving table relations, views, and catalog interactions within SQL analysis.

classes.name: RelationResolution
classes.description: Class responsible for resolving table and view relations, managing catalog interactions, and caching within Spark SQL analysis.

methods.name: expandIdentifier
methods.description: Expands a relation identifier with catalog and namespace info based on context.

methods.name: lookupTempView
methods.description: Looks up a temporary view by its identifier.

methods.name: resolveRelation
methods.description: Resolves an unresolved relation to a logical plan, considering time travel and streaming options.

methods.name: resolveTempView
methods.description: Resolves a temporary view to a logical plan, with checks for streaming and time travel.

methods.name: resolveReference
methods.description: Resolves a V2 table reference to a logical plan.

methods.name: getOrLoadRelation
methods.description: Retrieves a relation from cache or loads it if not present.

methods.name: loadRelation
methods.description: Loads a relation from a catalog based on a V2 table reference.

methods.name: adaptCachedRelation
methods.description: Adapts a cached relation to a new plan, updating tags.

methods.name: matchesReference
methods.description: Checks if a relation matches a given V2 table reference.

methods.name: cloneWithPlanId
methods.description: Clones a logical plan and tags it with a plan ID.
